source.mirror: Portolan FIRMS catalog on Source Cooperative

processing.geometry: DuckDB Spatial ST_Within against disclosed rectangular AOIs
processing.yearPruning: one exact yearly detections.parquet URL per scan plus explicit year predicate
processing.duplicateDefinition: identical acquisition UTC, sensor, satellite, quality, FRP, day/night, native confidence, type code and point coordinates
processing.utc: source acq_datetime and acq_date interpreted as UTC
processing.coverage: unknown; positive-only detections cannot establish observed no-fire

caveat: Counts are raw sensor detections, not unique fires or burned area. MODIS and VIIRS are not directly comparable. Climate, cloud, smoke, overpass timing, sensor availability and land management can affect the record; this pipeline does not infer causes or observation coverage.
